newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Barrett Resources cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Barrett Resources cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said on Monday it was downgrading its recommendation for Barrett Resources Corp to hold from buy.
-- The drop reflects "the strong stock-price appreciation and concerns about investor reaction to the stepped-up Gulf of Mexico exploration program," analyst Tom Driscoll wrote in a report.
-- "We are reducing our earnings-per-share forecasts to $0.85 in 1996 and $1.65 in 1997, as a result of higher costs tied to Gulf of Mexico exploration," Driscoll said.
-- Barrett Resources' stock was trading unchanged at 35-1/2.
